description: Local-first knowledge base for Markdown files
notes: Update kknow with 'scoop update kknow'. The update button in the app installs a second copy from the MSI package.
Thus turn off 'Settings -> General -> Update automatically' in the app.
The settings are in '%APPDATA%\dev.kknow.desktop'. Scoop does not keep them, and 'scoop uninstall' does not remove them.
